audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Poppy / Skill / Morde x5. The 692-game packet reads Skill / Morde / Morde / Skill / Morde / Poppy / Poppy.
audit.why: The page's own whys already say it: whys[0] 'neither of us has a real all-in', whys[3] 'Even window', whys[5] 'She out-scales', whys[6] 'Late game she's a near-unkillable anti-engage tank'.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, Mordekaiser, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item and 2+ items were written as Mordekaiser spikes.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence passively grants armour and MR that INCREASES as she drops low, so every tank item compounds against flat magic damage; Keeper's Verdict (140/120/100s) removes you from the fight at the exact moment your aura should be paying off.
audit.corrected: Your spikes stay level 2-3 and level 6 (Realm of Death, 140s, 650 range); both item rows go to Poppy.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and Heroic Charge was described as a flat 'wall-pin stun' without the condition.
audit.why: Heroic Charge: 475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s, 'dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned' — in open ground it is only a displacement. Steadfast Presence (20/18/16/14/12s) stops DASHES only, which is why Death's Grasp still lands. Keeper's Verdict is an interruptible channel.
audit.corrected: Fight in open ground so Heroic Charge cannot stun; her W never stops your E pull; interrupt or bait the R channel.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Poppy dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when she commits to a CS.
edits.after: One ability each and no aura stacks yet — neither of you has an all-in, so just farm with Q and spend nothing into her at level 1.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Poppy must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Even window — Darkness Rise favours the long trade, but Heroic Charge pins you to a wall for a stun on 14s if you fight near one.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Poppy out-scales: Steadfast Presence stacks armour and MR that climbs further the lower her health drops.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Poppy's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: She becomes a near-unkillable anti-engage tank, and Keeper's Verdict knocks you clean out of Darkness Rise range the moment you commit the all-in.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Poppy Steadfast Presence: Resists + STOPS enemy dashes nearby; grounds them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Poppy Heroic Charge (E): matchup-defining — a 475-range push on 14s; only a wall turns it into a stun. Fight in open ground. - Poppy Keeper's Verdict (R): a 140s channel — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Charge is 14s at rank 1 — only a wall makes it a stun.

edits.before: That is Poppy's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Fight in open ground — with no wall behind you Heroic Charge is only a push.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a 140s channel — interrupt it, or bait it before you R.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops dashes, never your Death's Grasp pull — but her armour and MR rise as she drops low, so a long grind favours her.

notes: Chart was wrong in five of seven rows against a 692-game packet while the page's own whys already described those rows correctly; proposed as one atomic paired group. Poppy Q carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's text does not support (it is a slow zone that explodes) — not asserted. Poppy W genuinely does stop dashes and ground, and the page already handles the important consequence correctly: Death's Grasp is a pull, not a dash, so Steadfast Presence does not stop it. STYLE ISSUE for the user: this matchup's content layer is written in FIRST person ('I farm with Q', 'my Death's Grasp') rather than the second-person voice used everywhere else in the champion. Fixing it means rewriting whys[0..6], early, mid and late wholesale; I did not touch them because each rewrite risks the length band for no factual gain. Flagged below. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Obliterate can interrupt Keeper's Verdict's channel, and whether Heroic Charge's stun duration is affected by tenacity.
